Bonus.global_skill: Bonus to skills and attacks (not saves)

KeyBrowser.DslHint: Put the key on the left into the effect's change row and the built string into its value. Change mode (Add/Override) is irrelevant. Give a consumable carrier a duration (usually 1 round).
KeyBrowser.InvalidDsl: The modifier string failed validation — see console (F12) for details.

Op.damage: damage — addition to the damage formula

OpHint.attack: Stacks with other bonuses. Consumed after the attack roll by default.
OpHint.damage: Number or dice (1d6). Appended to the formula as is, not shifted by the Ladder. Consumed after the damage roll.
OpHint.dice_step: 1d4→1d6→2d4→2d6→2d8→3d6; total raise is capped at +1 step, negative N is an uncapped nerf. Consumed after the damage roll.
OpHint.pierce: Each point removes 10% of the target's DR; stacks with weapon armor piercing. Consumed after the damage roll.
OpHint.ap_discount: Discounts stack, cost never below 0. Consumed when AP is spent.
OpHint.ap_set: The minimum of several values is used. Consumed when AP is spent.

power.1: −1 penalty to the target's next roll (DC 10)
power.3: −2 penalty for [Doctrine Rank] rounds OR a condition (DC 14)
power.4: −3 penalty for [Doctrine Rank] rounds OR a condition (DC 16)

constrain.5: Deep freeze: full paralysis for 1 round

knockdown.3: Wash away: push 4 m and knock prone

dust_veil.2: Vision impaired in the Area: −2 to attacks into/out of/through it, normal sight limited to 2 m

adapt.1: Temporary rank 1 mutation (hostile targets get a save)
adapt.2: Temporary rank 2 mutation (hostile targets get a save)
adapt.3: Temporary rank 3 mutation (hostile targets get a save)
adapt.4: Temporary rank 4 mutation (hostile targets get a save)
adapt.5: Temporary rank 5 mutation (hostile targets get a save)

imbuement.1: +1 to a skill/defense, OR +1 elemental weapon damage, OR DR 1 vs one damage type
imbuement.2: +2 to a skill/defense, OR +2 elemental weapon damage, OR DR 2 vs one damage type
imbuement.3: +3 to a skill/defense, OR +3 elemental weapon damage, OR DR 3 vs one damage type
imbuement.4: Weapon strikes one Ladder step higher

ItemSheet.EffectLightConfigHint: Configure token light (radius, color, animation); this effect will illuminate its bearer
ItemSheet.LightConfigHint: Both radii at 0 removes light from the effect. To turn it off temporarily, uncheck "Enabled" (the effect stays). Light is stored as regular effect changes (token.light.*) and applies to the bearer's token while the effect is active: light from an unequipped item or a suppressed effect goes out on its own.
ItemSheet.EffectSelfHint: Apply to owner when the item is used (@spentAp, @apCost, @overspent available)
ItemSheet.EffectAuraPayloadHint: Aura payload: applied to tokens inside the owner's aura
ItemSheet.EffectAuraConfigHint: Configure aura (radius, targets); this effect becomes the aura marker
ItemSheet.AuraConfigHint: Radius 0 removes the aura entirely (settings are lost). To turn it off temporarily, uncheck 'Aura enabled' — or right-click the aura icon in the effects HUD; the item's chat card has a toggle button too. While enabled, an aura region follows each of the owner's tokens and applies this item's payload effects (marked with the bullseye icon) to tokens inside. If no payload effects are marked, this effect's own changes are distributed instead. Enable 'Affects the bearer' for the owner to receive the aura.
ItemSheet.DamageFormulasHint: The formula next to a damage type is used by maneuvers of that type; if empty, the base damage formula applies.
ItemSheet.SpellBuildHint: This spell was built by the Constructor. Edit the build via the "Build a Spell" button in the window header; the fields below can be edited manually, but the cost is recalculated from the build on cast (a mismatch is whispered to the GM).
ItemSheet.CohesionHint: Cohesion N cancels N incoming Armor Piercing (Cleaving N on a weapon cancels it back). NOT yet part of damage resolution — the field is filled in ahead of time
ItemSheet.CleavingHint: Cleaving N cancels N of the target armor's Cohesion. NOT yet part of damage resolution — the field is filled in ahead of time
ItemSheet.DeflectingWeaponHint: +N to Block while held in the off hand. The shield's currency: medium 1, tower 2
ItemSheet.ArmorPropertiesHint: The system derives property mechanics on its own — no need to duplicate them in Modifiers
ItemSheet.ArmorModifiersHint: Only extras on top of the pattern (material, enchantment). Armor type and property bonuses are computed by the system. Ranged/magic attack penalties are not applied yet
ItemSheet.IsReloadActionHint: Reloads the selected reloading weapon; its AP cost is taken from the weapon (Reload Cost).
ItemSheet.IsScrollReadHint: Casts the selected scroll's spell; AP cost comes from the scroll (by rarity), paid with universal AP only, the scroll is consumed.
ItemSheet.ExperienceHint: Enter a positive number to grant XP, or a negative number (e.g. -5) to deduct XP.
ItemSheet.CurrencyItemHint: The denomination must match a currency key from world settings. When picked up/deposited, coins move into the wallet.
ItemSheet.ServiceHint: A service is intangible: it has no weight and is not added to inventory. On purchase, money is deducted and the item's Active Effects (if any) are applied.
ItemSheet.SpellIsFixedHint: No Constructor build: only the Doctrine Rank is checked on cast. For long casts and linear spells.
